definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately hiding something, especially wrongdoing, evidence, or information that should be disclosed.

examples.japanese: {証拠|しょうこ}を{隠蔽|いんぺい}する。
{会社|かいしゃ}は{不正|ふせい}を{隠蔽|いんぺい}しようとした。
examples.english: The company tried to cover up the misconduct.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}{隠蔽|いんぺい}が{発覚|はっかく}し、{大|おお}きなスキャンダルになった。
examples.english: The information cover-up came to light and became a major scandal.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{証拠|しょうこ}を{隠蔽|いんぺい}する - to conceal evidence
・{事実|じじつ}を{隠蔽|いんぺい}する - to cover up facts
・{情報|じょうほう}{隠蔽|いんぺい} - information concealment
・{隠蔽|いんぺい}{工作|こうさく} - cover-up operation

NUANCE:
This word has a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate and often illegal concealment of wrongdoing.

RELATED WORDS:
・{発覚|はっかく} - coming to light (opposite outcome)
・{暴露|ばくろ} - exposure (the act of revealing)
・{捏造|ねつぞう} - fabrication
